# Leader Service

> Leader Service (Leader Service Group Canada Inc.) is a residential and commercial mechanical service company based at 132 Corstate Avenue, Unit 100, Concord (Vaughan), Ontario L4K 4X2, Canada. It provides plumbing, heating, boiler, furnace, air conditioning, hydronic radiant and snowmelt, water heater, drain, sump pump and backwater valve, water filtration, flood response, commercial HVAC, backflow testing and preventative maintenance services across Vaughan and the Greater Toronto Area, with 24/7 emergency response. Phone 437.476.4832, email info@ldrservice.com.

Key facts:
- Service area: Vaughan, Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, Concord, King City, Richmond Hill, Toronto and the surrounding Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada.
- Two divisions: Leader Home Services (residential, including custom and estate homes) and Leader Mechanical Services (commercial, industrial, institutional and multi-residential).
- Part of the Leader family of companies; Leader Mechanical has installed mechanical systems in the GTA for three generations.
- Maintenance program: one binary membership (no tiers), priced from a property walkthrough on the systems actually covered; 10% repair discount; no truck, call-out or fuel charges on program work; transfers on sale. Residential 12-month auto-renewing; commercial 12 or 36 months.
- Open 24/7 for emergencies.

## Services
- [Boiler Service](https://ldrservice.com/residential/boiler-service/): A residential boiler should be serviced once a year, ideally in early fall before the heating season. A proper service includes a combustion analysis, a check of the burner, heat exchanger, venting and safety controls, a look at system pressure and the expansion tank, and a written record of what was found. Leader Service does this across Vaughan and the GTA.
- [Furnace Service](https://ldrservice.com/residential/furnace-service/): A gas furnace should be inspected and cleaned once a year, before the heating season. Annual maintenance checks the burners, ignition, flame sensor, heat exchanger, venting, blower and filter, and confirms the furnace is burning safely. It is the simplest way to avoid a mid-winter breakdown and catch carbon monoxide risks early.
- [Air Conditioning](https://ldrservice.com/residential/air-conditioning/): A central air conditioner or heat pump should be serviced once a year, in spring before the cooling season. Service includes cleaning the outdoor coil, checking refrigerant pressures and temperatures, testing the capacitor and contactor, clearing the condensate drain and confirming airflow. Clean, correctly charged equipment cools better, costs less to run and lasts longer.
- [Plumbing](https://ldrservice.com/residential/plumbing/): Leader Service provides licensed residential plumbing across Vaughan and the Greater Toronto Area: leak detection and repair, fixture and faucet installation, shut-off and pressure valves, repiping, water heaters, sump pumps and drains. Emergency plumbing calls such as burst pipes and active leaks are answered 24/7 at 437.476.4832.
- [Water Heaters & Tankless](https://ldrservice.com/residential/water-heaters/): A tankless water heater should be descaled and serviced once a year in the GTA, because the region's hard water builds scale inside the heat exchanger. Tank water heaters benefit from an annual flush, an anode rod check and a test of the temperature and pressure relief valve. Leader Service services, repairs and installs both.
- [Drain Cleaning](https://ldrservice.com/residential/drain-cleaning/): Leader Service clears blocked sinks, floor drains and main sewer lines 24/7 across Vaughan and the GTA. After clearing a main drain we recommend a camera inspection, which shows whether the blockage came from roots, grease, a sag or a broken pipe, so you know whether the fix was permanent or the line needs repair.
- [Sump Pumps & Backwater Valves](https://ldrservice.com/residential/sump-pumps/): A sump pump and a backwater valve protect a basement in two different ways. The sump pump removes groundwater from around the foundation; the backwater valve stops sewage from flowing back into the house when city sewers surcharge. Both should be tested at least once a year, and a battery backup keeps the sump running during a power outage.
- [Water Filtration & Softening](https://ldrservice.com/residential/water-filtration/): Water in York Region and much of the GTA is hard, which leaves scale in tankless heaters, boilers, fixtures and appliances. A water softener removes the hardness minerals, a whole-home filter improves taste and removes sediment and chlorine, and a reverse osmosis system provides drinking water. Homes on private wells may also need UV treatment.
- [Radiant & Hydronic Heating](https://ldrservice.com/residential/radiant-heating/): Hydronic radiant floor and snowmelt systems should be checked every fall: system pressure, glycol concentration and pH on snowmelt and glycol loops, circulator pumps, mixing valves, zone valves and controls. Balanced and maintained, radiant heat is the quietest and most even heat a home can have. Leader Service maintains these systems in custom homes across the GTA.
- [Emergency Flood Response](https://ldrservice.com/residential/flood-response/): In a flood, the first priorities are safety, stopping the source and getting water out quickly, because mould can start within 24 to 48 hours. Leader Service responds 24/7 across Vaughan and the GTA to stop the leak or backup, extract water, set up drying and dehumidification, and document the damage for your insurance claim.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://ldrservice.com/commercial/hvac/): Commercial rooftop units and air handlers are typically maintained quarterly or semi-annually depending on the equipment and load: filters, belts, coils, burners, refrigerant circuits, economizers and controls. Leader Service runs documented preventative maintenance and 24/7 repair for offices, retail, plazas and industrial buildings across Vaughan, Concord and the GTA.
- [Backflow Testing](https://ldrservice.com/commercial/backflow-testing/): In Vaughan and most GTA municipalities, industrial, commercial, institutional and multi-residential properties must have a backflow prevention device on their water service and have it tested by a qualified tester at least once a year, with the test report submitted to the municipality. Leader Service schedules each device on its anniversary date and handles the paperwork.
- [Commercial Boilers](https://ldrservice.com/commercial/commercial-boilers/): Commercial boilers should have at least an annual service before the heating season, including combustion analysis, safety and operating control tests, burner and heat exchanger inspection, and checks of pumps, expansion tanks and water treatment. Larger plants usually need additional seasonal visits. Leader Service maintains boiler plants for commercial and multi-residential buildings across the GTA.
- [Commercial Plumbing](https://ldrservice.com/commercial/commercial-plumbing/): Leader Service provides commercial plumbing for offices, retail plazas, restaurants and industrial buildings across Vaughan, Concord and the GTA: fixture and washroom repairs, domestic hot water, booster and sump pumps, grease interceptors, drain lines and backflow prevention. Work is scheduled around your operations and documented for your records.
- [Building Maintenance Programs](https://ldrservice.com/commercial/maintenance/): A commercial preventative maintenance program schedules every mechanical asset in a building at its own required frequency, documents each visit, and turns surprise breakdowns into planned work. Leader Service builds one agreement per building covering HVAC, boilers, plumbing and backflow compliance, with terms of 12 or 36 months and no truck or call-out fees on program work.

## FAQ
- **What areas does Leader Service serve?** Vaughan (including Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, Concord and Thornhill), King City and King Township, Richmond Hill, Toronto and the surrounding Greater Toronto Area.
- **Do you offer 24/7 emergency service?** Yes. No-heat, burst pipe, drain backup and flood emergencies are answered 24/7 at 437.476.4832.
- **Do you serve both homes and commercial buildings?** Yes. Leader Home Services covers residential properties and Leader Mechanical Services covers commercial, industrial, institutional and multi-residential buildings.
- **How is Leader Service related to Leader Mechanical?** Leader Service is the service and maintenance company of the Leader family of businesses. Leader Mechanical has installed mechanical systems in GTA homes and buildings for three generations; Leader Service maintains and repairs them.
- **How does the maintenance program work?** A property is either on the program or not; there are no tiers. We walk the property, inventory every mechanical system, and price the program on the systems you choose to cover, each serviced at its own correct interval.
- **What does the maintenance program include?** Priority dispatch, a 10% repair discount on any repair (including systems not on the program), an annual digital service report, online access to your service history, no call-out or truck charges on program work, and transfer to the new owner if you sell.
- **How long is the maintenance agreement?** Residential agreements are 12 months and renew automatically, with 30 days' notice to cancel. Commercial agreements are 12 or 36 months with 60 days' notice.
- **Can I pay monthly?** Yes. Every agreement can be billed annually or monthly, at the same price either way.
- **Do you charge a service call or truck fee?** Not on maintenance program work. For one-off service calls, we explain any diagnostic or trip charge before booking.
- **Do you give prices before starting work?** Yes. You get the price and approve it before any repair begins.
- **Do you do backflow testing?** Yes, for commercial, industrial, institutional and multi-residential properties, with each device tracked to its annual due date.
- **How do I book?** Call 437.476.4832, email info@ldrservice.com, or use the booking form on any page of this site.
